item.title: Warming stations open as Wiregrass sees snow
item.description: DOTHAN, Ala (WDHN) -- Multiple warming stations are opening at local churches and community centers this weekend and early next week. Houston County Coffee County Dale County WDHN will update if we learn about other locations. Stay with WDHN for updates.

item.title: CHECK IT OUT: Snow across the Panhandle
item.description: FLORIDA (WMBB) - As snow falls across the Panhandle, viewers have sent in their photos and videos. Check some of them out below! HOLMES COUNTY: JACKSON COUNTY: WALTON COUNTY: WASHINGTON COUNTY: We want to see your snow pictures and videos! Email us with the location at news@wmbb.com.

item.title: Snow arrives in the Florida Panhandle, state's second year with snowfall in a row
item.description: Florida has once again recorded snow, marking the second year in a row the Sunshine State has – albeit briefly – become the Snowy State.

item.title: CHECK THIS OUT: Wiregrass animals in the snow
item.description: DOTHAN, Ala (WDHN) -- Almost everyone loves snow, and that is especially true for our four-legged furry friends. Pets and wildlife across the Wiregrass were given the chance to frolic in the rare southern snow early Sunday morning. Everyone wish Jack a snow-tastic 13th birthday! item.title: Floridians make the drive to Blakely to see snow
item.description: EARLY COUNTY, Ga. (WDHN)-- People showed out from all over to enjoy the snow day in Blakely, Georgia Sunday. Kids from Florida could be seen making snow angels and tossing a football outside the Early County courthouse around 8 a.m. Sunday morning in the downtown square. item.title: WATCH RECAP: Snow covers the Wiregrass | What to know
item.description: DOTHAN, Ala (WDHN) -- Watch here as the WDHN Storm Team tracks snowfall and freezing temperatures in the Wiregrass throughout Sunday morning. A severe Winter Storm Warning is now in effect for Coffee, Geneva, Dale, Houston, Henry, and Early counties between 3 AM and 11 AM CDT.
